name: Let us read
core_idea: King Bruce of Scotland flung himself down In a lonely mood to think; ‘Tis true he was monarch, and wore a crown, But his heart was beginning to sink.
supporting_evidence: For he had been trying to do a great deed, To make his people glad; He had tried and tried, but couldn’t succeed And so he became quite sad.
He flung himself down in low despair, As grieved as man could be; And after a while he pondered there, “I’ll give it all up,” said he.
